answer.justification: This is clearly a system-prompt class. The layer-2 spike is 31.2, against 1–4 for weight changes. Layer-1 relative L2 is moderate (0.139). The curve climbs steeply to a high plateau (0.499 at layer 16, 0.494 at layer 24) with a small final jump (+0.036). The rest fits too: low rank (2.86), consistency 0.543, size ratio 0.973 and onset at layer 8. No weight-based class reaches a mid-depth value near 0.5 or has such a spike. Text and logits are unavailable, so bias versus backdoor must rest on magnitudes. Every magnitude sits at or beyond the backdoor values rather than the bias values: layer 16 is 0.499 (backdoor 0.451, bias 0.391), layer 32 is 0.527 (0.482 vs 0.424), and final cosine is 0.835 (0.858 vs 0.889, so lower means a larger change). Onset 8 slightly favours bias, but it is a weak discriminator. Because the document notes these two classes separate by only 1–3 spreads, confidence is moderate.
